repaired.name: Scenario
repaired.script:
fired := false
if (fired == true) {
    wait until(not ((#Garden_Button).button_button == "pushed"))
    fired = false
}
wait until((#Garden_Button).button_button == "pushed")
(#Garden_Valve).valve_open()
fired = true

diagnosis.summary: The IR specifies a rising-edge wait (`wait(Button.Button == "pushed", edge rising)`), which requires blocking until the transition occurs. The candidate uses a periodic `if` guard, which only evaluates at the start of the cycle period. Evidence F1 shows the button state changed at t=0ms (held for 100ms), and F2 confirms the JoI emitted no action at t=100ms because the `if` guard evaluated to false at t=0ms and the next evaluation at t=1000ms was outside the observed window. The fix implements the rising-edge state machine using blocking waits.
diagnosis.change_summary: Replaced the periodic `if` guard with a rising-edge state machine: initialize `fired := false`, block on the false state if previously fired, block on the true state to trigger the action, and update state. This preserves the 1 SEC period between completed bodies while correctly reacting to the rising edge at t=0ms.
